# IPD Agent Workflow Framework v0.3.1-beta

[English](#english) | [简体中文](#简体中文)

## English

This maintenance beta corrects how the generated Dashboard communicates
Deliverable dependencies. Workflow facts and lifecycle contracts remain
compatible with v0.3.0-beta.

### Highlights

- Render dependency flow from prerequisite to dependent while preserving the
  canonical machine edge contract (`source=dependent`, `target=prerequisite`).
- Keep the Deliverable dependency view focused on `depends_on`; `supports`,
  `verifies`, and `supersedes` remain traceability relations and no longer
  influence dependency topology.
- Distinguish a planned Deliverable waiting on prerequisites from an explicitly
  blocked Deliverable, so normal dependency waiting is not shown as a red
  lifecycle blocker.
- Add explicit SVG direction metadata, localized reading guidance, and
  regression tests for direction, filtering, readiness, and layout stability.
- Smoke-test the bilingual Skill ZIP in the automated release workflow as well
  as the wheel and source distribution.

### Upgrade

Existing projects do not need to run `ipdctl tailor` again. Upgrade the Skill
and runtime, then regenerate and verify derived views:

```bash
ipdctl refresh <project>
ipdctl verify <project>
```

### Compatibility

- Python 3.10 or newer; CI verifies Python 3.10 and 3.14.
- Package version `0.3.1b1`, public release label `v0.3.1-beta`, and CLI
  version `0.3.1-beta`.
- Task profiles, tailored processes, project state, Agent Runtime records,
  schemas, IDs, statuses, and canonical graph edge semantics are unchanged
  from v0.3.0-beta.
- Dashboard output is derived data. Upgrading changes the rendered projection,
  not the authoritative YAML facts.

### Approval boundary

An Agent may prepare evidence, reviews, and Gate readiness, but it cannot issue
a final approval. Deliverable acceptance and final TR/DCP approval require an
explicitly authorized human review record. The framework stores the record; it
does not provide enterprise identity verification.

### Known limitations

- This release does not provide a hosted service, authenticated enterprise
  approval, live collaboration, or a writable web Dashboard.
- The Dashboard is generated as offline HTML/SVG/JSON files and must be
  regenerated with `ipdctl refresh` after source facts change.
- Git/SVN integration is intentionally read-only. Repository mutations remain
  the responsibility of the user or a separately authorized automation.
- Real project source, test, firmware, hardware, and documentation paths need
  explicit artifact bindings; the framework does not infer ownership from
  directory names.
- Project-specific technical architecture and domain capability packs are not
  introduced by this maintenance release.

### Release assets

- `ipd-agent-workflow-skill-v0.3.1-beta.zip`: bilingual Skill source archive.
- `ipd_agent_workflow_skill-0.3.1b1-py3-none-any.whl`: Python wheel.
- `ipd_agent_workflow_skill-0.3.1b1.tar.gz`: Python source distribution.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: SHA-256 checksums for all three distributions.

## 简体中文

本维护版 Beta 修复了 Dashboard 对交付件依赖关系的表达。流程事实和生命
周期契约继续兼容 v0.3.0-beta。

### 主要变化

- 依赖流按“前置项到依赖项”渲染，同时保持机器契约不变：依赖项是
  `source`，前置项是 `target`。
- 交付件依赖视图只使用 `depends_on`；`supports`、`verifies` 和
  `supersedes` 仍是追溯关系，但不再影响依赖拓扑。
- 区分“等待前置项的 planned 交付件”和“明确处于 blocked 状态的交付件”，
  正常依赖等待不再显示为红色生命周期阻塞。
- 增加明确的 SVG 方向元数据、本地化阅读说明，以及覆盖方向、关系过滤、
  readiness 和布局稳定性的回归测试。
- 自动发布流程除 wheel 和源码分发包外，也会对双语 Skill ZIP 执行
  Smoke Test。

### 升级方式

已有项目不需要重新执行 `ipdctl tailor`。更新 Skill 与运行时后，重新生成
并验证派生视图：

```bash
ipdctl refresh <project>
ipdctl verify <project>
```

### 兼容性

- 支持 Python 3.10 及以上版本；CI 验证 Python 3.10 和 3.14。
- Python 包版本为 `0.3.1b1`，公开版本标签为 `v0.3.1-beta`，CLI 版本为
  `0.3.1-beta`。
- Task Profile、Tailored Process、Project State、Agent Runtime 记录、
  Schema、ID、状态和规范图边语义均与 v0.3.0-beta 保持一致。
- Dashboard 是派生数据。升级改变的是渲染投影，不是权威 YAML 事实。

### 审批边界

Agent 可以准备证据、评审和 Gate readiness，但不能给出最终批准。交付件
验收以及最终 TR/DCP 批准必须包含明确授权的人类评审记录。框架负责保存
记录，但不提供企业身份认证。

### 已知限制

- 本版本不提供托管服务、企业级身份认证审批、实时协作或可写 Web Dashboard。
- Dashboard 是离线生成的 HTML/SVG/JSON 文件；事实源变化后必须执行
  `ipdctl refresh` 重新生成。
- Git/SVN 集成有意保持只读；版本库写入仍由用户或另行授权的自动化完成。
- 真实项目中的源码、测试、固件、硬件和文档路径需要显式 artifact binding；
  框架不会根据目录名推断所有权。
- 本维护版本不引入项目专属技术架构或领域 capability pack。

### 发布产物

- `ipd-agent-workflow-skill-v0.3.1-beta.zip`：双语 Skill 源码包。
- `ipd_agent_workflow_skill-0.3.1b1-py3-none-any.whl`：Python wheel。
- `ipd_agent_workflow_skill-0.3.1b1.tar.gz`：Python 源码包。
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`：上述三个分发包的 SHA-256 校验和。
